contentText:
Microsoft is getting ready to show the first gameplay of Forza Horizon 6 next week , and it might also be ready to put a date on its release, too. X poster Xbox Infinite claims they received a Forza Horizon 6 preorder notification inside Forza Horizon 5 , implying that the release date of the new title is May 19th.

I haven't been able to reproduce the message myself, but the X poster claims it appeared in the garage section of Forza Horizon 5 . Sources tell me that Microsoft has been planning to release Forza Horizon 6 in the May timeframe, so this date does align with Microsoft's plans.
